visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up of a young woman with light brown hair, wearing a blue sweatshirt and a necklace. She is smiling widely, displaying high excitement, and making a peace sign with her hand. Behind her is a large billboard featuring portraits of several men in suits (Super Junior members). The setting is a brightly lit indoor concourse. (2) The scene shifts to the same woman posing in front of a large cylindrical pillar featuring a solo portrait of a male celebrity (Heechul). She is wearing a blue hoodie and jeans, carrying several shopping bags, and making various playful poses and peace signs while other people walk by in the background. (3) The perspective changes to a massive indoor concert venue. Thousands of fans are visible, holding glowing blue lightsticks. On a large elevated stage, several performers are visible under dramatic red and white spotlights. (4) A close-up shows a drummer on a raised platform within the concert venue, playing a drum kit with intensity as spotlights beam across the dark arena. (5) The camera captures the group of male performers on stage, waving to the audience from a high platform. (6) On a massive video screen, one member is shown in a close-up wearing a blue hoodie and a flamboyant feathered headpiece. (7) Blue streamers fall from the ceiling over the cheering crowd. A small picture-in-picture window in the corner shows the woman's ecstatic facial expression as she records the moment. (8) The setting moves to a backstage area with dark curtains. The woman is standing with the male celebrity from the posters. She hands him a pair of wooden drumsticks, and they interact closely, both looking happy and engaged in conversation. (9) A final still photo shows the woman and the male celebrity standing side-by-side, each holding a pair of drumsticks, in front of a door labeled 'Dress Room'.
